scope: Additional exact restriction on same-base publication reuse if the actual selected plan includes pairedEvidence; not a newly selected plan or capture result.

rules.fact: Only contracts crossdeck.phase2.continuity and crossdeck.refit.companion can select the existing paired evidence configuration. The actual fresh plan decides applicability.

Reuse requires equal baseSha/sourceDigest/contractDigest/recordDigest, the immutable original executed candidate tree, executed candidate ancestry and no post-capture change outside pairedPublicationPathAllowed.

Allowed publication changes are Development_Docs/**/*.md, docs/**/*.md, Development_Docs/Features/catalog/crossdeck.json, CHANGELOG.md, .agents/crossdeck-refit-checkpoint.md, Development_Docs/document-index.json, Development_Docs/Programs/Other/Ledgerlight/Project_Ledgerlight_Documentation_Migration_Matrix.csv, Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Crossdeck/evidence/**, and Development_Docs/Testing/Product_Experience/candidate-review.json or evidence/**.

notBlanketAllowedAfterCapture: new JSON under the NCL engineering evidence folder
nclImplication.preparation: Freeze NCL automation, native/consumer source, catalog decisions and engineering evidence before capture; later normal capture/review publication must satisfy the installed allowlist. This note does not request or propose widening it.
nclImplication.baseAdvance: Even source-equivalent new protected-base reconciliation still fails the ordinary generic capture base binding without fresh normal evidence. Explicit Crossdeck adoption is not available to NCL.
nclImplication.readiness: This restriction does not prevent the current legitimate installed790 NCL capture attempt after publication; it governs admissible later reuse/publication.
